title: Blemished Sacrifices
summary: Sacrificial animals were to be offered with reverence, not carelessness or contempt.
background: Malachi rebukes offerings that showed dishonor toward God. The issue was not merely ritual quality but the heart revealed by giving God what was damaged or unwanted.
teachingHelp: Teach this as a call to honor God with sincere worship, not leftovers or religious appearances.
